title: Package to Table Continuity
description: Four reference-linked lifestyle scenes establishing a coherent package-to-table food system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the kitchen palette, package visibility, servingware family, and home-use realism. Images 02-04 preserve that same domestic system while rotating meal stage and family-use emphasis.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-pantry-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
